items.source: Creates a new configurer that will use the given resourceLoader and properties.
items.translation: 创建一个新的配置器，该配置器将使用给定的 resourceLoader` 和properties`。

items.source: Can be injected into application code and used to define a custom RabbitConnectionFactoryBean whose configuration is based upon that produced by auto-configuration.
items.translation: 可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义自定义的 RabbitConnectionFactoryBean`，其配置基于自动配置所产生的配置。

items.source: Creates a new configurer that will use the given resourceLoader, properties, connectionDetails, and sslBundles. The connection details have priority over the properties.
items.translation: 创建一个使用给定的 resourceLoader`、properties`、connectionDetails` 和 sslBundles` 的新配置器。连接详情优先于属性。

items.source: Creates a new configurer that will use the given resourceLoader, properties, and connectionDetails. The connection details have priority over the properties.
items.translation: 创建一个使用给定的 resourceLoader`、properties` 和 connectionDetails` 的新配置器。连接细节的优先级高于属性。

items.source: Configure the specified rabbit connection factory bean. The factory bean can be further tuned and default settings can be overridden. It is the responsibility of the caller to invoke RabbitConnectionFactoryBean.afterPropertiesSet() though.
items.translation: 配置指定的 RabbitConnectionFactoryBean 工厂 Bean。该工厂 Bean 可进一步调整，并可覆盖默认设置。不过，调用者有责任调用 RabbitConnectionFactoryBean.afterPropertiesSet()`。

items.source: Chris Bono, Moritz Halbritter, Andy Wilkinson, Phillip Webb, Scott Frederick
items.translation: Chris Bono, Moritz Halbritter, Andy Wilkinson, Phillip Webb, Scott Frederick
